attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 5 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page is two sentences long. He is neither of the two Gerontii the corpus already keeps: `gerontius-the-martyr` is a martyr the Romanian calendar names on 1 aprilie, and `gerontius-the-athonite` is the venerable Gherontie the Romanian keeps on 26 iulie — different days, different ranks, and neither is a bishop in Italy. No hymn, no relics, no city of birth.
